title: cycnium recurvum
intro: Cycnium recurvum, commonly known as the "Twisted Navelwart" or "Blue Devil", is a type of flowering plant in the bignonia family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The plant is said to possess therapeutic actions such as wound healing and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Cycnium recurvum include iridoids, phenolic compounds, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
